name: foundry-dev
postStartCommand:
if ! grep -qs 'MISE_FNOX_BOOTSTRAP' /root/.bashrc; then printf '
# MISE_FNOX_BOOTSTRAP (mise+fnox+az)
export MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/.mise
export FNOX_STATE_DIR=/workspaces/.fnox-state
if [ -n "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" ] && ! az account show >/dev/null 2>&1; then az login --service-principal -u "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" -p "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" -t "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
mise trust /workspaces/foundry-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
eval "$(mise activate bash)" 2>/dev/null || true
eval "$(fnox activate bash)" 2>/dev/null || true
' >> /root/.bashrc; fi; (cd /workspaces/foundry-dev && MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/.mise mise install >/dev/null 2>&1) || true; MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/.mise mise use -g fnox@latest >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; mkdir -p /workspaces/.vscode-extensions /root/.vscode-server && ln -sfn /workspaces/.vscode-extensions /root/.vscode-server/extensions; az bicep install >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
